stem: Voltmarkt sold 1,600 headphones in October 2025. Of those units, 72 came back in October, 40 in November and 8 in December. In October Voltmarkt also received 18 returned headphones that had been sold in September. Voltmarkt counts each return in the month of the original sale. What is the returns rate for October's headphone sales? Give a percentage with 1 decimal.
